basis: docs/source-ladders.md approved field ladders; not independent source-quality certification

baseline.name: OpenStreetMap
baseline.reason: Keyless nearby discovery; community claims need verification.

baseline.name: Venue website
baseline.reason: Existing bounded linked-venue checks; identity, robots and network safety still apply.

baseline.name: Google Maps
baseline.reason: Directions links; no Places API or inferred travel time.

JP.name: Japan (Tokyo pilot)

sources.name: Tabelog
sources.reason: Local dining signal; retain original score scale and review count. Direct access remains disabled until terms review.

sources.name: Google Maps
sources.reason: Use tappable links and only observed facts; do not infer current status from a link.

sources.name: Venue website
sources.reason: Prioritize venue-published hours and booking facts; apply the existing verification safeguards.

sources.name: TableCheck, Gurunavi and NAVITIME
sources.reason: Corroborate observed hours, menu and booking information; direct adapters are not enabled.

sources.name: HotPepper Gourmet
sources.reason: Account/free-tier eligibility has not been verified.

notes: No automatic chain, cafe or family-restaurant exclusion. That requires an explicit user preference.

TH.name: Thailand (Bangkok field ladder)

sources.name: Wongnai and LINE MAN
sources.reason: Local dining signal from the approved field ladder; direct adapters are not enabled.

sources.name: Michelin Guide
sources.reason: Guide signal where a venue is actually listed; no inferred coverage.

sources.name: Venue website
sources.reason: Verify hours and menu through the existing linked-venue adapter.

sources.name: Chope and Grab Dine Out
sources.reason: Booking leads only; no account or direct adapter enabled.

notes: Confirm transport, queue tolerance and seating needs; do not invent traffic estimates.

ID.name: Indonesia (Bali field ladder)

sources.name: Chope and Grab Dine Out
sources.reason: Booking leads; availability and direct access remain unverified.

sources.name: Venue website
sources.reason: Verify hours and published facts through the existing linked-venue adapter.

sources.name: Local guides
sources.reason: Use attributed guide evidence and cross-check venue identity; no bundled guide endorsement.

sources.name: TripAdvisor
sources.reason: Tourist-signal cross-check only, not the primary quality ranking.

notes: Confirm transport and family needs; traffic, heat and rain require actual evidence.
